title: Karla Turner's abductees describe a control system run from a metallic sphere (the Moon)

tellings.quote: where they said that we are in a control system that's being managed from out of a metallic sphere just beyond the earth.

plain: People who say they were taken by aliens told the researcher Karla Turner, who wrote about abduction cases in the 1990s, that 'we are in a control system that's being managed from out of a metallic sphere just beyond the earth', which the story takes to be the Moon. The philosopher Jason Jorjani relays this to Michels, setting it beside Far Journeys, a book by Robert Monroe, a writer on out-of-body travel. If true, it would mean humanity is being watched and steered from close by.
